context: Extend SourceConfig parsing and GitSource resolution with an optional safe relative subdir; reject absolute paths and traversal; include the subdir in provenance; add source and manifest tests plus docs; build, lint, typecheck, and test; publish through a focused PR to skill-sync main.
description: BenchBox must stop materializing governance skills from the mutable dirty ~/.skill-sync checkout. skill-sync supports pinned Git refs but assumes each skill is at repository root; skill-sync-skills stores them under skills/. Add a validated optional subdir field for Git sources so BenchBox can source the exact canonical commit without local-WIP leakage.

anti_patterns.dont: Join an unchecked subdir directly to the clone path
anti_patterns.instead: Validate it as a normalized repository-relative path
anti_patterns.why: Traversal could resolve skills outside the cloned repository

anti_patterns.dont: Teach BenchBox to depend on a mutable local checkout
anti_patterns.instead: Add the missing general Git-source capability
anti_patterns.why: Local WIP must not determine committed agent governance

preserves.behavior: A subdir cannot escape the cloned repository
Existing Git sources without subdir behave identically
Source provenance records enough information to reproduce the resolved skill location

work_units.evidence: feat/git-source-subdir: SourceConfig/GitSource support validated normalized subdir; traversal, absolute, Windows-style, and non-git use rejected; targeted 40 tests pass
work_units.summary: Add and validate optional Git source subdir in manifest and source resolution

work_units.evidence: README/docs updated; provenance includes subdir; manifest round-trip and factory/source regression tests added; npm lint, tsc, and full 401-test suite pass
